author: mthuret
subject: v4.1.0-beta.3
bodyLines: * **error:** reset error when receiving results of a query (not when sending it) (algolia/react-instantsearch#179) ([0118ba0](https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch/commit/0118ba0))
* **highlight:** wrong parsing between client and server (algolia/react-instantsearch#183) ([179f7e8](https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch/commit/179f7e8))
* **highlight:** We remove the timestamp present in our highlight preTag and postTag. If you were using regex to parse the
highlighting results then you'll need to adapt it as now it's only "ais-highlight".
